name: SoLiD26 solid–liquid interface configurations

count_scope: Aqueous metal/electrode–electrolyte interfaces and selected liquid/solid references from VASP PBE+D3 calculations.

sources.title: SoLiD26 revised preprint
sources.evidence: Reports 15,379,823 configurations, up to 576 atoms and 15 elements; revised Data Availability links the public archive.

sources.title: Materials Cloud SoLiD26 v1
sources.evidence: Published 2026-10-13, open under CC BY 4.0; lists 16 compressed ASE-LMDB shards, checksums, README and split indices.

caveats: Frames derive mainly from AIMD, not 15.38 million independent equilibrium crystals.
The first preprint said available by request; the revised paper and October public deposit supersede that access statement.
ASE fixed-atom constraints can zero returned forces; provider directs users to raw forces or get_forces(apply_constraint=False).
Full 63.8 GiB compressed release was not downloaded or independently recounted.

name: SevenNet-Omni domain-bridging set (DBS)
description: New single-point DFT labels align geometries sampled across molecular, bulk, surface and MOF parent datasets.
count_scope: New single-point DFT labels align geometries sampled across molecular, bulk, surface and MOF parent datasets.

sources.title: SevenNet-Omni paper
sources.evidence: Methods reports about 125,000 DBS geometries selected from MatPES, OC20, OC22, ODAC23, OMol25 and QCML with new compatible VASP single points.

sources.title: DBS Figshare v3 metadata
sources.evidence: CC BY 4.0; identifies dbs_total.extxyz (779,700,511 bytes), parent-source db_label semantics and separate benchmark/model files.

caveats: The count is the bridging set, not the much larger 15-dataset aggregate used to train the model.
Geometries overlap existing parent corpora; new labels do not imply new independent material identities.
Includes isolated molecules and other non-crystal domains; select the periodic subset for solid-only work.
Large DBS payload not downloaded; approximate paper count retained.

sources.evidence: Describes unique 3-periodic carbon allotropes, separate ideal-net and optimized CIFs and DFT-derived property fields.

sources.title: SACADA live table response
sources.evidence: Public GET contract read from the site HTML; independently counted 1,661 rows with 1,661 unique IDs.

sources.title: SACADA diamond example
sources.evidence: Public ZIP inspected: dia/dia.cif and dia/dia_IN.cif; cell and atomic-coordinate fields present.

caveats: Table entries are allotrope/net records, not experimentally realized phases.
Some records are topology-only or change topology on optimization; coordinate and property completeness varies.
Ideal-net and optimized CIFs represent the same entry and are not counted twice.
Only a sample coordinate ZIP was inspected; table-row count does not certify a complete CIF for every row.

name: sysTEm systematically verified experimental thermoelectrics
description: Curated experimental thermoelectric transport values with publication and source-dataset provenance.
count_scope: Curated experimental thermoelectric transport values with publication and source-dataset provenance.

sources.title: sysTEm author repository
sources.evidence: Describes MRL/ESTM merger and systematic zT consistency checks with a 10% tolerance; lists columns and units.

sources.title: Current final workbook
sources.evidence: Independently counted 8,650 nonempty data rows/unique row IDs and 1,437 standardized composition strings; temperature range 10–1275 K.

sources.title: sysTEm repository license
sources.evidence: Repository declares MIT; parent-source lineage remains explicit.

caveats: Overlaps existing ESTM and extended MRL data; do not sum parent and merged counts.
Rows are temperature observations, not 8,650 distinct materials.
Formula consistency checks do not independently reproduce measurements; not every row has every target.
No atomic coordinates are supplied by this workbook.

additional_counts.scope: Distinct current Pymatgen Composition strings; not independently deduplicated experimental specimens
